border-guard.abilityText:

Reveal the top 2 cards of your deck. Put one into your hand and discard the other. If both were Actions, take the Lantern or Horn.

cargo-ship.abilityText:
+$2

ducat.abilityText:

experiment.abilityText:

horn.abilityText: Once per turn, when you discard a Border Guard from play, you may put it onto your deck.

key.abilityText: At the start of your turn, +$1.

lantern.abilityText: Border Guards you play reveal 3 cards and discard 2. (It takes all 3 being Actions to take the Horn.)

treasure-chest.abilityText: At the start of your Buy phase, gain a Gold.
